items: “Adjusted Net Investment Income” and “Adjusted Net Investment Income Per Share”: represent net investment income, excluding any change in capital gains incentive fees accrued but not payable. These fees are related to cumulative unrealized gains in excess of cumulative net realized gains less any cumulative unrealized losses, less capital gains incentive fees paid inception to date.
“Adjusted Net Income” and “Adjusted Net Income Per Share”: represent net income, excluding any change in capital gains incentive fees accrued but not payable.
